notes: The high-speed train (YHT) takes 2.5 hours from Istanbul and 1.5 hours from Ankara. The city tram (ESTRAM) goes everywhere in town. You will need a car for the Phrygian Valley and Sivrihisar.
Çibörek, balaban köfte, met helvası and Tatar mantı are local specialities, and Odunpazarı has plenty of çibörek places.
Winters are cold (-5°C) and snowy. Odunpazarı looks lovely under snow, and the museums are indoor options.
Odunpazarı Modern Museum is closed on Mondays. Entry is about 300 TL.
It is a student city: cafes are cheap and the evenings are lively.
Roads in the Phrygian Valley are dusty in summer, so set off early in the morning.

stops.name: Odunpazarı Houses
stops.tips: Colourful Ottoman houses with bay windows and cobbled streets, quiet in the morning.

stops.name: Odunpazarı Modern Museum
stops.tips: Kengo Kuma's timber museum: contemporary Turkish art, with architecture that is an exhibit in itself.

stops.name: Çibörek Evi Odunpazarı
stops.tips: Tatar çibörek (fried meat pastry), served hot with ayran. Three or four will fill you up.

stops.name: Meerschaum Museum Eskişehir
stops.tips: Meerschaum carving in Odunpazarı, with a workshop and museum.

stops.name: Kurşunlu Complex
stops.tips: Odunpazarı's Ottoman complex, home to glass art workshops.

stops.name: Porsuk River Gondola Tour
stops.tips: Take a gondola from Köprübaşı for a Venice feel, calm in the morning.

stops.name: Köprübaşı
stops.tips: The heart of the city, with bridges over the Porsuk and cafes.

stops.name: Haller Youth Centre
stops.tips: Cafes and art in the old market hall, with a student-town atmosphere.

stops.name: Mangal Keyfi Eskişehir
stops.tips: One of Eskişehir's best-known meat restaurants, famous for balaban köfte.

stops.name: Kent Park Eskişehir
stops.tips: An artificial beach and park on the Porsuk: sand beach in summer, walks in winter.

backups.name: Eskişehir Contemporary Arts Gallery
backups.tips: A gallery in the centre, good for a rainy day.

stops.name: Sazova Science, Culture and Art Park
stops.tips: A fairytale castle, pirate ship and Japanese garden, good for a walk with or without children.

stops.name: Sabancı Space House
stops.tips: Planetarium show, inside the park.

stops.name: Sazova Cafe
stops.tips: Lunch inside the park.

stops.name: Eti Underwater World
stops.tips: Tunnel aquarium, inside the park.

stops.name: Kentpark Waterfront Walk
stops.tips: An evening walk along the Porsuk.

backups.name: Air Museum Eskişehir
backups.tips: Aircraft museum, an alternative to the aquarium.

stops.name: Yazılıkaya Midas Monument
stops.tips: 80 km from Eskişehir: a Phrygian rock monument and the city of Midas, best in morning light.

stops.name: Phrygian Valley Rock Churches
stops.tips: Rock tombs and churches at Han, reached on foot.

stops.name: Han Village Restaurant
stops.tips: A village restaurant serving kuru fasulye (white bean stew) and gözleme (stuffed flatbread).

stops.name: Ayazini Village
stops.tips: Cappadocia-like fairy chimneys and a rock church, the loveliest village in the Phrygian Valley.

backups.name: Seyitgazi Complex
backups.tips: The tomb of Battal Gazi and the complex, an alternative to Ayazini.

stops.name: Sivrihisar Grand Mosque
stops.tips: A Seljuk mosque with wooden columns, one hour from Eskişehir.

stops.name: Sivrihisar Armenian Church
stops.tips: A restored church, now a cultural centre.

stops.name: Sivrihisar Nasreddin Hoca House
stops.tips: Hoca's birthplace, the village of Hortu, is nearby. In town there is a memorial house.

stops.name: Sivrihisar Yemekçi
stops.tips: A town restaurant serving kuru fasulye (white bean stew) and rice pilaf.

stops.name: Pessinus Ancient City
stops.tips: A Cybele temple and theatre at Ballıhisar, in a Phrygian-Roman city.

backups.name: Nasreddin Hoca Hortu Village
backups.tips: Hoca's village, an alternative to Pessinus.

stops.name: Eskişehir Archaeology Museum
stops.tips: Finds from Dorylaion and the Phrygians.

stops.name: Glass Arts Museum
stops.tips: Glassblowing in Odunpazarı, with workshops to watch.

stops.name: Ciğerci Eskişehir
stops.tips: Eskişehir's liver wrap (ciğer dürüm), a student classic.

stops.name: Tepebaşı Art Street
stops.tips: Cafes and street art.

stops.name: Vişnelik Garden Eskişehir
stops.tips: A city garden for a stroll.

backups.name: Eskişehir Caricature Museum
backups.tips: Caricature art in Odunpazarı, an alternative to the glass museum.

stops.name: Odunpazarı Bazaar
stops.tips: Meerschaum, met helvası and glass souvenirs.

stops.name: Odunpazarı Breakfast Place
stops.tips: Breakfast, with met helvası for dessert.

stops.name: Eskişehir Railway Station
stops.tips: High-speed train: Ankara in 1.5 hours, Istanbul in 2.5 hours. Time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Odunpazarı Tatar Mantı House
backups.tips: Tatar mantı (small dumplings), a farewell meal.
